centralized_energy_architecture.reference_function: A central energy source and distribution system supporting propulsion and ship systems.
centralized_energy_architecture.real_translation: Power generation, conditioning, storage, distribution, fault isolation, and load shedding.

sublight_maneuvering.real_translation: Chemical propulsion, reaction-control thrusters, or low-thrust electric propulsion with explicit thrust, mass, and propellant limits.
unavailable_claims: relativistic crewed acceleration without propellant and energy accounting

acceleration_load_management.reference_function: Protect occupants and structure from acceleration changes.
acceleration_load_management.real_translation: Acceleration limits, thrust shaping, seats and restraints, structural-load envelopes, isolation mounts, and mission profiles.

debris_and_radiation_protection.reference_function: Protect the ship from debris, radiation, and hostile environmental energy.
debris_and_radiation_protection.real_translation: Whipple-style shielding lineage, pressure-vessel protection, radiation monitoring and shielding, debris tracking, avoidance, and fault-tolerant placement.

integrated_command_computer.reference_function: Ship-wide command, diagnosis, navigation, and autonomous support.
integrated_command_computer.real_translation: Deterministic command software, autonomous remote operations, fault-tolerant avionics, onboard navigation, and explicit human/AI governance.

multi_domain_sensing.real_translation: Instrument-specific sensor suites with noise, calibration, field of view, bandwidth, latency, and uncertainty.

docking_and_logistics.reference_function: Transfer people, cargo, samples, and equipment between locations.
docking_and_logistics.real_translation: Rendezvous, docking, robotics, cargo transfer, teleoperation, and logistics planning.

onboard_fabrication.reference_function: Create or repair required items during a mission.
onboard_fabrication.real_translation: Additive manufacturing, recycling, inventory management, repair tooling, and closed-loop resource recovery.

immersive_simulation.reference_function: Shared immersive simulation, training, recreation, and visual reasoning.
immersive_simulation.real_translation: Procedural cockpit visualization, VR/AR, simulation rooms, digital twins, and interactive mission rehearsal.

artificial_gravity_by_rotation.reference_function: Provide sustained body loading during long missions.
artificial_gravity_by_rotation.real_translation: Microgravity operations or future rotating-habitat acceleration when geometry, radius, spin rate, Coriolis effects, and structural loads are explicitly modeled.
unavailable_claims: static gravity generation without rotation or acceleration
